title: Hugo GT - I Can Feel Your Lies
htmlContent:
Hugo GT shares a new single called "I Can Feel Your Lies". The production sets the perfect tone with the music, as his vocal performance guides the way on what is an amazing musical experience. The song describes the feeling of finally giving up on this person's shit and not caring anymore and feeling much better about it cause there's too much crap in life to deal with someone like that.

Everything you need to hear from an artist today is what is given from Hugo GT on his new song “I Can Feel Your Lies”. The musicianship displayed is genius from the incredible vocal performance, the amazing songwriting, and the genius level production that creates the perfect storm of amazing music, on this record that makes you enjoy life.

Stream here:
https://hugogt.ca
